subject: dym-ft
title: DYM.FT.------ACC.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 63 (BK(NM)-39). DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism) is the subject; ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and PART (participation). From TRS: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DY: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis). From SPT-DY: RIT-DT. From RIT-DT: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From PART: INFO-SOLD (information solidification).
